macros.name: CommandForEach
macros.doc: The command \CommandForEach executes the same control sequence (or token list) for each item in a list.

macros.name: DefineArrayDefault
macros.doc: The command \DefineArrayDefault can be used to access the contents of a group of variables that have been defined with \DefineArrayVar or \DefineArrayVars. It defines a new control sequence whose expansion depends on the value of another variable.

macros.name: DefineArrayVarTo
macros.doc: The command \DefineArrayVarTo assigns the same content to a group of variables.

macros.name: ExitForEach
macros.doc: The command \ExitForEach stops the execution of the list after the current item has been processed.

macros.name: ExitForEachLevels
macros.doc: The command \ExitForEachLevels stops the execution of the array at the levels indicated in its arguments have been processed. It takes effect after the current item has been processed.

macros.name: ForArray
macros.doc: The command \ForArray processes the contents of an array.

macros.name: ForEach
macros.doc: The command \ForEach can be used to process the items of a list.

macros.name: ForEachD
macros.doc: The command \ForEachD allows to change the category codes of characters during the execution of the list.

macros.name: ForEachSublevel
macros.doc: The command \ForEachSublevel processes the the contents of a item of a surrounding list processing command.

macros.name: ForEachX
macros.doc: The command \ForEachX processes the list of items in the same way as the command \ForEach. However, it expands its third argument, a token containing the actual list, before processing it.

macros.name: thislevelitem
macros.doc: \thislevelitem is a \long macro that expands to the token list of the item.
